identity.title: Make every button interaction state theme-complete

origin.summary: The owner requested a complete audit of button click, hover, focus, and disabled presentation, including whether an available action visibly looks actionable and whether every state matches the OpenVisionLab graphite theme.

state.current_summary: The whole ButtonBase correction is complete: all 315 declarations and 31 local style owners are guarded, zero explicit styles bypass both a themed base and complete template, all nine post-correction app-facing templates own required interaction states and semantic glyphs, and current Release Wide/Compact representative normal, selected, disabled, Viewer-toolbar pressed, and dynamic-dialog pressed evidence passes without inspection execution.

objective.summary: Every app-owned button family communicates availability and interaction consistently through graphite-themed normal, hover, pointer-down, keyboard-focus, selected, and disabled states without platform-default visual leakage.
constraints: Preserve explicit Preview, Publish, Run, recipe, source, ROI, result, and active-layer contracts.
Reuse existing semantic theme resources and Wpf.Ui base styles before adding new resources or templates.
Keep icon-only controls tooltiped and accessibly named.
Verify current Release Wide 1920 x 1040 and Compact 1280 x 760 on the dynamically selected leftmost monitor.
Do not commit, push, version, or release without explicit owner authorization.

criteria.text: The complete app-owned inventory covers all 315 ButtonBase declarations, 31 style owners, seven app-facing custom templates, dynamic dialog buttons, and template-generated button children without tag-only counting gaps.

Every explicit button style either derives from the supported themed base or owns a complete semantic template; no platform-default surface or white flash appears in normal, hover, pointer-down, focus, selected, or disabled states.

Every app-facing custom button template has distinct pointer hover, actual pointer-down, keyboard focus, selected/checked where applicable, and disabled presentation, and icon glyphs consume semantic foreground brushes rather than hard-coded active colors.

Source-wide verification enforces every style owner, while current Release Wide and Compact evidence exercises representative changed owners and dynamic/template-generated controls with actual held pointer-down capture without inspection execution.

milestones.summary: Shared base-style routing and Viewer toolbar correction
Custom template pressed, focus, disabled, and icon-brush correction

context.summary: Graphite semantic brushes, Window button styles, and mode RadioButton template.
Viewer toolbar Button/ToggleButton styles and hard-coded Path strokes.
Rail, Viewer layout, Selected Tool section header, Height Image, diagnostics, recipe, and explorer button styles.

artifacts.summary: Whole-source control/style/template inventories, Release build and focused verification output, and current Wide/Compact UI captures.

evidence.observation: XAML parsing found 268 Buttons (133 WPF and 135 Wpf.Ui), 16 ToggleButtons, 15 RadioButtons, and 16 CheckBoxes: 315 ButtonBase controls total. The audit found 31 local style owners and seven app-facing custom templates; 11 styles have neither BasedOn nor a full template, six templates lack IsPressed, two lack IsEnabled presentation, and one lacks keyboard-focus presentation.

Current Release Wide and Compact normal captures exited 0 and intersected the dynamically selected leftmost monitor. Direct UI review confirmed shared Wpf.Ui hover/focus and subdued disabled states, but the Viewer Top/Perspective checked button renders a bright platform-style surface and system-like hover instead of graphite semantic selected/hover colors. The current message-dialog held-pointer smoke exited 1 before producing its pressed report, leaving that current-build pressed qualification unavailable.

Current Release Workbench/theme verification passes 98/98. Its button checks confirm 315 ButtonBase declarations, 31 local style owners, nine post-correction app-facing templates, dynamic dialog creation and primary identity, zero unbased/untemplated explicit styles, zero incomplete template states, and zero hard-coded active button glyph colors.

evidence.kind: current Release Wide and Compact state qualification
evidence.observation: Release build passes with zero warnings/errors. Wide 1920x1040 and Compact 1280x760 normal captures remove the prior bright Viewer selected surface; Viewer toolbar and dynamic dialog primary held-pointer captures exit 0, are accepted on attempt 1, and record held ButtonBase pressed state. Shell captures intersect the dynamically selected leftmost monitor bounds -2400,456,0,1806. Shell smoke options pass 42/42 and no inspection action was invoked.

events.summary: Owner approved implementation of the audited button-state corrections.

Qualification separates exhaustive source/style/template ownership from representative actual rendering of changed custom owners and dynamic controls; a test-only gallery of all 315 controls is outside the product requirement.
All corrected button-state ownership, build, regression, and representative current-Release Wide/Compact visual gates passed.
